subject: University Health Portal - Appointment Confirmation
body:
Dear $first_name $last_name,

Your appointment has been successfully scheduled with the University Health Center.

Appointment Details:
Appointment ID: $appointment_id
Type: $appointment_type
Date: $appointment_date
Time: $appointment_time
Provider: $provider

Please arrive 15 minutes before your scheduled appointment time.

If you need to reschedule or cancel your appointment, please log in to the Health Portal
or contact the Health Center at health@university.edu or call 555-123-4567.

Thank you,
University Health Center
